{"target_smiles":"COc1c(N)c(F)c(F)c2c1[nH]c(=O)n2-c1ccc(I)cc1F","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本逆合成路线针对目标分子中高度官能团化的苯并咪唑-2-酮骨架展开逆向分析。首先将咪唑酮环断开为邻芳基二胺前体与羰基二咪唑（CDI），利用分子内五元环闭环的高反应性，克服环外孤立伯胺的竞争干扰，实现选择性成环。紧接着，三胺骨架中相连的两个氨基溯源至相应的二硝基前体，通过双硝基还原一步构筑，巧妙规避了多官能团芳烃的繁琐保护基操作。进一步分析，该二硝基联芳胺骨架的关键C-N键可通过芳香亲核取代反应（SNAr）断开为3,4,5-三氟-2,6-二硝基苯甲醚与市售的2-氟-4-碘苯胺。由于3,4,5-三氟-2,6-二硝基苯甲醚具有良好的C2v对称性，其C3和C5位的氟原子同时受到邻位和对位强吸电子硝基的活化，亲核取代仅产生单一区域异构体。最终，该对称多氟二硝基中间体可由市售大宗化学品3,4,5-三氟苯甲醚经一步双硝化制备。全合成路线高度简洁高效，反应物均易得且在12个重原子以内。","key_disconnection_class":"carbonyldiimidazole cyclization","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":4,"strategy":"基于对称三氟苯甲醚亲核取代与咪唑酮环化的收敛路线","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"COc1c(N)c(F)c(F)c2c1[nH]c(=O)n2-c1ccc(I)cc1F","precursors":["COc1c(N)c(F)c(F)c(Nc2ccc(I)cc2F)c1N","O=C(n1ccnc1)n1ccnc1"],"reaction_class":"carbonyldiimidazole cyclization"},{"step_id":2,"product":"COc1c(N)c(F)c(F)c(Nc2ccc(I)cc2F)c1N","precursors":["COc1c([N+](=O)[O-])c(F)c(F)c(Nc2ccc(I)cc2F)c1[N+](=O)[O-]"],"reaction_class":"nitro reduction"},{"step_id":3,"product":"COc1c([N+](=O)[O-])c(F)c(F)c(Nc2ccc(I)cc2F)c1[N+](=O)[O-]","precursors":["COc1c([N+](=O)[O-])c(F)c(F)c(F)c1[N+](=O)[O-]","Nc1ccc(I)cc1F"],"reaction_class":"nucleophilic aromatic substitution"},{"step_id":4,"product":"COc1c([N+](=O)[O-])c(F)c(F)c(F)c1[N+](=O)[O-]","precursors":["COc1cc(F)c(F)c(F)c1"],"reaction_class":"nitration"}],"starting_materials":["COc1cc(F)c(F)c(F)c1","Nc1ccc(I)cc1F","O=C(n1ccnc1)n1ccnc1"]}]}

{"target_smiles":"Cc1cc(Nc2ncc(Br)c(N[C@H](C)CO)n2)cc(C)c1S(N)(=O)=O","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本路线采取高度汇聚式的合成策略。首先在第一步将目标分子关键的C-N键断开，拆分为两段核心砌块：(S)-2-((5-溴-2-氯嘧啶-4-基)氨基)丙-1-醇和4-氨基-2,6-二甲基苯磺酰胺，通过钯催化的Buchwald-Hartwig胺化反应将两片段高效拼接。对于嘧啶侧链砌块，利用5-溴-2,4-二氯嘧啶中C4位氯的高亲电性，与手性氨基醇(S)-丙氨醇发生高区域选择性的亲核芳香取代反应构筑。对于苯胺磺酰胺片段，则以廉价易得的3,5-二甲基苯胺为原料，经乙酰化保护氨基后，利用芳环上甲基与乙酰氨基协同的定位效应，与氯磺酸发生高区域选择性氯磺酰化，随后与氨水反应形成磺酰胺，最后酸性水解脱除乙酰基得到游离苯胺。整条路线原料廉价易得，各步转化均具有良好的化学选择性与区域选择性。","key_disconnection_class":"Buchwald-Hartwig amination","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":6,"strategy":"嘧啶核汇聚式偶联与苯磺酰胺片段构建","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"Cc1cc(Nc2ncc(Br)c(N[C@H](C)CO)n2)cc(C)c1S(N)(=O)=O","precursors":["Cc1cc(N)cc(C)c1S(N)(=O)=O","C[C@H](CO)Nc1nc(Cl)ncc1Br"],"reaction_class":"Buchwald-Hartwig amination"},{"step_id":2,"product":"C[C@H](CO)Nc1nc(Cl)ncc1Br","precursors":["Clc1ncc(Br)c(Cl)n1","C[C@@H](N)CO"],"reaction_class":"Nucleophilic aromatic substitution"},{"step_id":3,"product":"Cc1cc(N)cc(C)c1S(N)(=O)=O","precursors":["CC(=O)Nc1cc(C)c(S(N)(=O)=O)c(C)c1"],"reaction_class":"Amide hydrolysis"},{"step_id":4,"product":"CC(=O)Nc1cc(C)c(S(N)(=O)=O)c(C)c1","precursors":["CC(=O)Nc1cc(C)c(S(=O)(=O)Cl)c(C)c1","N"],"reaction_class":"Sulfonamide formation"},{"step_id":5,"product":"CC(=O)Nc1cc(C)c(S(=O)(=O)Cl)c(C)c1","precursors":["CC(=O)Nc1cc(C)cc(C)c1","O=S(=O)(O)Cl"],"reaction_class":"Chlorosulfonation"},{"step_id":6,"product":"CC(=O)Nc1cc(C)cc(C)c1","precursors":["Cc1cc(C)cc(N)c1","CC(=O)OC(C)=O"],"reaction_class":"Acylation"}],"starting_materials":["CC(=O)OC(C)=O","C[C@@H](N)CO","Cc1cc(C)cc(N)c1","Clc1ncc(Br)c(Cl)n1","N","O=S(=O)(O)Cl"]}]}

{"target_smiles":"Cc1cc(N)cc(CN2CCCC2)c1N1CCN(C)CC1","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本合成路线以廉价易得的2-氟-3-甲基苯甲醛为起始原料。首先利用浓硝酸对芳环进行区域选择性硝化，在甲酰基的间位导向与氟原子的对位导向协同控制下，硝基专一性地引入到氟原子的对位，高产率得到2-氟-3-甲基-5-硝基苯甲醛。随后，利用对位硝基和邻位甲酰基的双重强吸电子活化效应，加入1-甲基哌嗪在温和条件下发生芳香亲核取代反应，高效构建芳基哌嗪C-N键。接下来，所得醛基中间体与四氢吡咯在三乙酰氧基硼氢化钠作用下进行还原胺化反应，将吡咯烷甲基片段顺利安装到芳环上。最后，通过钯碳催化加氢或铁粉还原法，高选择性地将芳环硝基还原为游离氨基，完成目标分子的全合成。整条路线具有高度的化学选择性和简洁性。","key_disconnection_class":"nitro reduction","disconnection_type":"fgi","planned_num_steps":4,"strategy":"从邻氟苯甲醛出发经硝化、SNAr及还原胺化合成","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"Cc1cc(N)cc(CN2CCCC2)c1N1CCN(C)CC1","precursors":["Cc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc(CN2CCCC2)c1N1CCN(C)CC1"],"reaction_class":"nitro reduction"},{"step_id":2,"product":"Cc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc(CN2CCCC2)c1N1CCN(C)CC1","precursors":["Cc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc(C=O)c1N1CCN(C)CC1","C1CCNC1"],"reaction_class":"reductive amination"},{"step_id":3,"product":"Cc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc(C=O)c1N1CCN(C)CC1","precursors":["Cc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc(C=O)c1F","CN1CCNCC1"],"reaction_class":"nucleophilic aromatic substitution"},{"step_id":4,"product":"Cc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc(C=O)c1F","precursors":["Cc1cccc(C=O)c1F","O=[N+]([O-])O"],"reaction_class":"nitration"}],"starting_materials":["C1CCNC1","CN1CCNCC1","Cc1cccc(C=O)c1F","O=[N+]([O-])O"]}]}

{"target_smiles":"CC1=NOC(c2ccc(Cl)cc2)(c2ccc(N)c(C)c2)C1","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本逆合成路线针对含双芳基季碳中心的3-甲基-4,5-二氢异𫫇唑啉骨架进行逆切。首先，目标分子苯环上的游离氨基在多步反应中容易发生副反应，因此最后一步设计通过温和的选择性硝基还原引入苯胺结构，以避免官能团不兼容性。异𫫇唑啉五元杂环的核心骨架通过乙腈氧化物与1,1-二芳基乙烯的[3+2]偶极环加成反应高效构筑，该反应具有优异的区域选择性与转化率。关键的双芳基烯烃中间体则由相应的二芳基甲酮经经典Wittig烯化反应制备。进一步逆推二芳基甲酮，可将其切断为氯苯与3-甲基-4-硝基苯甲酰氯的Friedel-Crafts酰基化反应，利用氯苯的对位定位效应区域专一地组装骨架。最后，酰氯前体可由廉价易得的间甲基苯甲酸经区域选择性硝化与氯化两步转化获得。整条路线汇聚高效，原料均为简单易得的大宗化学品。","key_disconnection_class":"Nitro reduction","disconnection_type":"fgi","planned_num_steps":6,"strategy":"硝基还原与偶极环加成构建异𫫇唑啉","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"CC1=NOC(c2ccc(Cl)cc2)(c2ccc(N)c(C)c2)C1","precursors":["CC1=NOC(c2ccc(Cl)cc2)(c2ccc([N+](=O)[O-])c(C)c2)C1"],"reaction_class":"Nitro reduction"},{"step_id":2,"product":"CC1=NOC(c2ccc(Cl)cc2)(c2ccc([N+](=O)[O-])c(C)c2)C1","precursors":["C=C(c1ccc(Cl)cc1)c1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])c(C)c1","CC(Cl)=NO"],"reaction_class":"1,3-dipolar cycloaddition"},{"step_id":3,"product":"C=C(c1ccc(Cl)cc1)c1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])c(C)c1","precursors":["Cc1cc(C(=O)c2ccc(Cl)cc2)ccc1[N+](=O)[O-]","C[P+](c1ccccc1)(c1ccccc1)c1ccccc1.[Br-]"],"reaction_class":"Wittig olefination"},{"step_id":4,"product":"Cc1cc(C(=O)c2ccc(Cl)cc2)ccc1[N+](=O)[O-]","precursors":["Clc1ccccc1","Cc1cc(C(=O)Cl)ccc1[N+](=O)[O-]"],"reaction_class":"Friedel-Crafts acylation"},{"step_id":5,"product":"Cc1cc(C(=O)Cl)ccc1[N+](=O)[O-]","precursors":["Cc1cc(C(=O)O)ccc1[N+](=O)[O-]"],"reaction_class":"Carboxylic acid chlorination"},{"step_id":6,"product":"Cc1cc(C(=O)O)ccc1[N+](=O)[O-]","precursors":["Cc1cccc(C(=O)O)c1","O=[N+]([O-])O"],"reaction_class":"Electrophilic aromatic nitration"}],"starting_materials":["CC(Cl)=NO","C[P+](c1ccccc1)(c1ccccc1)c1ccccc1.[Br-]","Cc1cccc(C(=O)O)c1","Clc1ccccc1","O=[N+]([O-])O"]}]}

route_text: {"target_smiles":"Cc1cc(N)cc(CN2CCCC2)c1N1CCN(C)CC1","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本合成路线以商业易得的2-氟-3-甲基苯甲酸为起始原料，经七步转化完成目标分子的合成。首先对2-氟-3-甲基苯甲酸进行甲酯化修饰以保护羧酸，随后利用混酸硝化反应在芳环的5-位（即氟原子的对位）高区域选择性地引入硝基；硝基的强吸电子效应显著活化了对位的氟原子，从而允许其与N-甲基哌嗪在温和条件下发生亲核芳香取代反应（SNAr），高产率构建芳基哌嗪骨架。随后，将对位取代物中的甲酯基团还原为苄醇，再经Dess-Martin氧化高选择性地转化为芳香醛中间体。利用该芳醛与四氢吡咯在三乙酰氧基硼氢化钠作用下进行还原胺化，高效构建吡咯烷甲基侧链。最后一步反应在催化加氢条件下将芳环上的硝基还原为目标芳香伯胺。该路线设计避免了早期游离氨基参与副反应，化学选择性优良且原料廉价易得。","key_disconnection_class":"Nitro reduction","disconnection_type":"fgi","planned_num_steps":7,"strategy":"硝基活化亲核芳取代与晚期还原胺化策略","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"Cc1cc(N)cc(CN2CCCC2)c1N1CCN(C)CC1","precursors":["Cc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc(CN2CCCC2)c1N1CCN(C)CC1"],"reaction_class":"Nitro reduction"},{"step_id":2,"product":"Cc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc(CN2CCCC2)c1N1CCN(C)CC1","precursors":["Cc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc(C=O)c1N1CCN(C)CC1","C1CCNC1"],"reaction_class":"Reductive amination"},{"step_id":3,"product":"Cc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc(C=O)c1N1CCN(C)CC1","precursors":["Cc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc(CO)c1N1CCN(C)CC1"],"reaction_class":"Dess-Martin oxidation"},{"step_id":4,"product":"Cc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc(CO)c1N1CCN(C)CC1","precursors":["COC(=O)c1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc(C)c1N1CCN(C)CC1"],"reaction_class":"Ester reduction"},{"step_id":5,"product":"COC(=O)c1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc(C)c1N1CCN(C)CC1","precursors":["COC(=O)c1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc(C)c1F","CN1CCNCC1"],"reaction_class":"Nucleophilic aromatic substitution"},{"step_id":6,"product":"COC(=O)c1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc(C)c1F","precursors":["COC(=O)c1cccc(C)c1F"],"reaction_class":"Nitration"},{"step_id":7,"product":"COC(=O)c1cccc(C)c1F","precursors":["Cc1cccc(C(=O)O)c1F","CO"],"reaction_class":"Fischer esterification"}],"starting_materials":["C1CCNC1","CN1CCNCC1","CO","Cc1cccc(C(=O)O)c1F"]}]}

{"target_smiles":"Cc1cc(-c2ccc(NC(=O)C(C)c3ccc(NC(C)C)cc3)cc2)ccn1","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本逆合成路线首先切断目标分子中心的酰胺键，将其解离为4-(2-甲基吡啶-4-基)苯胺和2-(4-(异丙基氨基)苯基)丙酸两大核心砌块。这一关键切断显著简化了分子骨架，消除了复杂的偶联产物。对于吡啶基苯胺片段，可通过4-溴-2-甲基吡啶与对氨基苯硼酸的高效Suzuki-Miyaura交叉偶联快速构建，两个前体均可在市售试剂中直接获得。对于苯基丙酸片段，合成难点在于苯胺氮上的单异丙基化修饰，通过以对氨基苯基丙酸与丙酮进行还原胺化反应，利用位阻效应可高选择性获得单烷基化产物，避免过度烷基化副反应；对氨基苯基丙酸则进一步通过硝基还原以及2-苯基丙酸的区域选择性硝化反应合成，最终回溯至市售廉价易得的2-苯基丙酸原料。整条路线具有高度汇聚性与良好的化学选择性。","key_disconnection_class":"Amide coupling","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":5,"strategy":"汇聚式酰胺缩合与还原胺化策略","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"Cc1cc(-c2ccc(NC(=O)C(C)c3ccc(NC(C)C)cc3)cc2)ccn1","precursors":["Cc1cc(-c2ccc(N)cc2)ccn1","CC(C)Nc1ccc(C(C)C(=O)O)cc1"],"reaction_class":"Amide coupling"},{"step_id":2,"product":"Cc1cc(-c2ccc(N)cc2)ccn1","precursors":["Cc1cc(Br)ccn1","Nc1ccc(B(O)O)cc1"],"reaction_class":"Suzuki-Miyaura coupling"},{"step_id":3,"product":"CC(C)Nc1ccc(C(C)C(=O)O)cc1","precursors":["CC(C(=O)O)c1ccc(N)cc1","CC(C)=O"],"reaction_class":"Reductive amination"},{"step_id":4,"product":"CC(C(=O)O)c1ccc(N)cc1","precursors":["CC(C(=O)O)c1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc1"],"reaction_class":"Nitro reduction"},{"step_id":5,"product":"CC(C(=O)O)c1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc1","precursors":["CC(C(=O)O)c1ccccc1"],"reaction_class":"Nitration"}],"starting_materials":["CC(C(=O)O)c1ccccc1","CC(C)=O","Cc1cc(Br)ccn1","Nc1ccc(B(O)O)cc1"]}]}

{"target_smiles":"Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)NCc2cc(=O)c(O)co2)cc1","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本逆合成路线围绕目标分子中磺酰胺键的构建展开。首先，在第一步关键切断中将分子断开为对甲苯磺酰氯与曲酸胺两个核心片段，利用伯胺与磺酰氯的高化学选择性缩合构筑磺酰胺连接。该方案的核心在于直接利用廉价大宗生物发酵天然产物曲酸作为骨架前体。曲酸胺片段合成的关键挑战在于避免酚羟基干扰下高效引入氨基。为此，首先利用二氯亚砜对曲酸侧链羟甲基进行选择性脱羟氯化制备氯代曲酸；随后与叠氮化钠发生亲核取代引入叠氮官能团；最后通过温和的还原反应将叠氮基还原得到游离曲酸胺。该路线原料均为商业易得大宗试剂，步骤紧凑且整体官能团兼容性良好。","key_disconnection_class":"sulfonylation","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":3,"strategy":"曲酸衍生化及磺酰胺化策略","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)NCc2cc(=O)c(O)co2)cc1","precursors":["Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1","NCc1cc(=O)c(O)co1"],"reaction_class":"sulfonylation"},{"step_id":2,"product":"NCc1cc(=O)c(O)co1","precursors":[],"reaction_class":"Staudinger reduction"},{"step_id":4,"product":"O=c1cc(CCl)occ1O","precursors":["O=c1cc(CO)occ1O","O=S(Cl)Cl"],"reaction_class":"chlorination"}],"starting_materials":["Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1","O=S(Cl)Cl","O=c1cc(CO)occ1O"]}]}
